description: Scoring labels for deliberately injected demo defects. The engine does not read this file.

defects.description: Cart total applies the tax twice.
Draft endpoint says saved without inserting a row.
Checkout accepts the same idempotency key repeatedly.
Checkout accepts negative and zero quantities.
Failed payment is recorded as paid and confirmed.
Order listing is available without authentication.
Order lookup ignores the caller's ownership.
Order state endpoint accepts invalid transitions.
Checkout accepts missing email and address fields.
Checkout does not persist a notification.
Stock decreases by one rather than by quantity.
Order remains committed when a later inventory operation fails.
Checkout converts exceptions into success responses with debug detail.
Frontend ignores the returned order id and retains stale state.
